description: Confirm and fund a deal awaiting confirmation (AWAITING_CONFIRM -> FUNDED).

deal_id.description: the deal id to confirm (AWAITING_CONFIRM -> FUNDED)

idempotency_key.description: caller idempotency key; replays are no-ops

signed_cart_mandate.description: optional signed cart mandate: standard base64 of a compact ES256 JWS (protected header members alg, typ and kid only; one signature) with a non-empty payload, signed with your own key. The JSON serialization, a detached JWS and other algorithms are refused

name: confirm_deal
